title: Economic Connectedness through Interaction between Families of Low and High Socio-economic Status
what_it_is: Economic Connectedness through Interaction between Families of Low and High Socio-economic Status

sections.label: Economic connectedness and social mobility
sections.summary: Studies, including ones cited by the Member in a past PQ, suggest economic connectedness supports social mobility.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Various studies, including the ones cited by the Member in a past Parliamentary Question (PQ), suggest that “economic connectedness” supports social mobility.

sections.label: Common spaces and integrated housing
sections.summary: Common spaces and integration of public rental flats with sold flats in BTO projects enable social mixing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: We provide common spaces where Singaporeans from all walks of life congregate, such as parks, hawker centres, playgrounds and sporting facilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: We have actively integrated public rental flats with sold flats in the same Build-To-Order (BTO) projects and within the same blocks where possible, including in Prime Location Housing areas, to enable social mixing.

sections.label: ComLink and Mentoring SG
sections.summary: ComLink matches volunteers to families as befrienders, and Mentoring SG supports youth development through mentoring.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Through Community Link, or ComLink, volunteers are matched to families as befrienders to better understand the families’ needs and aspirations, co-create individualised action plans with them and match them to relevant schemes, services and programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: More recently, we launched Mentoring SG, a national movement to support youth development through mentoring opportunities.

sections.label: Connections across socioeconomic backgrounds
sections.summary: Targeted programming lets connections across socioeconomic backgrounds offer information exchange, mentorship and job referrals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: With targeted programming, connections across socioeconomic backgrounds offer information exchange, mentorship and job referrals that could shape aspirations and expand opportunities for material improvement.

sections.label: SportCares and Junior Sports Academy
sections.summary: SportCares reaches low-income youths through sports, and scouted talents are placed in Junior Sports Academy or centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: For instance, under Sport Singapore (SportSG), there is SportCares, which reaches out to youths from low-income families through sports.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: Young talents who are good with their fundamental movement skills are recruited and scouted for their abilities at sports and then, placed in Junior Sports Academy or centres where talents from across different socio-economic groups are placed together.

sections.label: Replicating studies in Singapore
sections.summary: The Member's suggestion to replicate some studies in Singapore will be taken back to the Ministry, but not every study should be replicated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: I do note the Member's suggestion to replicate some of these studies in our context here in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: I will take that back to the Ministry, but I do want to put forth a note that we might not want to replicate every study that is out there, because that would not be a judicious use of our resources.
